notes: Gauge Emissions tracks weekly NEST emissions from the Minter Emission event on HyperEVM.
Permanently locked veNEST allocations and future-use treasury buckets are marked TBD because they do not have a liquid unlock schedule.
The Raise allocation was issued as max-locked veNEST (6 Months). We modeled it as a cliff 6 months after TGE

insiders.methodology: Tracks the team wallet receiving the team share of weekly emissions from the Minter. Received is a running total of an ongoing emission, not a fixed allocation. Staked tracks NEST locked into veNEST.
